dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical narrowing from the widest mid-body section toward both the anterior and posterior extremities.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight asymmetrical indentation on the right lateral margin mid-way along the visible body length.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Dark slate grey median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface, characteristic of high pigmentation.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Small, high-contrast white punctate marks in the anterior region and a prominent vertical light-colored linear mark along the posterior sagittal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct vertical linear mark or possible scratch located on the midline of the posterior dorsal area.
